name: choresync-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol server providing ChoreSync system inspection, OpenAPI contract discovery, database schema inspection, and cloud emulator telemetry.

tools.name: inspect_choresync_health
tools.description: Checks the live health and container status of ChoreSync services (Backend, Frontend, PostgreSQL, Floci)

service.description: Optional specific service to check (e.g. backend, frontend, postgres, floci)

tools.name: inspect_openapi_contract
tools.description: Reads and summarizes API endpoints, tags, and schemas from contracts/openapi.yaml

tag.description: Optional tag filter (e.g. Chores, Auth, Swaps, Rewards, Uploads)

tools.name: inspect_db_schema
tools.description: Inspects PostgreSQL DDL schema definitions, tables, and relational constraints in backend/internal/db/schema.sql

table.description: Optional specific table to inspect (e.g. chores, members, households)

tools.name: inspect_cloud_emulator
tools.description: Returns configuration and status for the local Floci cloud emulator (AWS S3 proof bucket and SQS nudge queue)
